title: Enhancing User Experience in Mental Health Applications: The Better Mood System
content: The use of technology in mental health programs has significantly increased access and interaction for users and psychology care. There is a newer platform known as BetterMood that focuses on making user interaction easier and making the registration of users requiring mental health care less complicated. Here, the work of research describes the system architecture of BetterMood, that is, the user registration procedure, and presents a sequence diagram describing the used verification mechanisms. Through the application of a formal validation process, BetterMood guarantees data accuracy and protection, ultimately providing an uninterrupted and trusted user experience. The results demonstrate the significance of clearly defined system interactions in instilling user trust and usability in digital mental health interventions.
